description: Land Acquisition - Horombawa, Kuliyapitiya-East D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Akurugoda, Kamburupitiya D/S Division, Matara District and an amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1243/9 of 02.07.2002, Medadumbara D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, including descriptions of specific land parcels to be acquired, their boundaries, extent, and compensation procedures. It falls under the "Land and property-related matters" category as it involves government acquisition of land for public purposes, which is the defining characteristic of Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
